faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Our main service is on Sunday at 10:00 AM. We also have a midweek service on Wednesdays at 7:00 PM.
faq.q2: Do you have programs for children?
faq.a2: Yes, we have a vibrant children's ministry for ages 0-12 during our Sunday service.
faq.a3: We have many small groups and volunteer opportunities. Please visit our contact page to get in touch with a ministry leader.
faq.a4: Our beliefs are rooted in the Bible and centered on Jesus Christ. You can find a detailed statement of faith on our (soon to be created) 'About Us' page.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.missionDescription: To spread the message of faith, hope, and love, fostering a global community of believers dedicated to spiritual growth and service. We aim to make the teachings of the Bible accessible to everyone, everywhere, empowering individuals to build a personal relationship with God.
aboutUs.faithDesc: Rooted in the teachings of Jesus Christ and the Holy Scripture.
aboutUs.communityDesc: Building strong, supportive relationships among believers.
aboutUs.serviceDesc: Serving others with love and compassion, following Christ's example.
aboutUs.integrityDesc: Upholding honesty and transparency in all our actions.
aboutUs.worshipDesc: Glorifying God in all that we do, in spirit and in truth.
aboutUs.discipleshipDesc: Helping believers grow in their faith and become followers of Christ.

startMeeting.title: Start a Bible Meeting
startMeeting.whatIsChurchDesc: A church is not a building, but a community of believers united by their faith in Jesus Christ. It's a spiritual family dedicated to worship, fellowship, discipleship, ministry, and evangelism. The early church met in homes, and this model emphasizes close-knit relationships and mutual support.
startMeeting.whatIsHomeChurchDesc: A home church is a small group of believers who meet regularly in a home instead of a traditional church building. It focuses on creating an intimate environment for worship, prayer, Bible study, and fellowship, fostering deeper connections and personal growth in a comfortable, accessible setting.
